note: Read 2026-10-30 on gov.vg. A first-time applicant must be at least 18 and a citizen, Belonger, resident, work permit or student holder of the Virgin Islands; the page lists the learner's permit ($20.00), cone test ($20.00) and road test ($20.00), not held, but no fee for the licence itself, and the renewal page gives $75.00 for a renewal without a term. So the fee and the term are null. The identity card is not this office's.

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands, Get A First Time Driver's Licence
sources.said: To begin the process of obtaining your first-time driver's licence, you must: Be at least 18 years old
